feeds.title: The Crochet Crowd » Baby Blankets
feeds.description: These are Crochet Baby Blankets Patterns. Most projects are at the easy level with some extending into intermediate level baby blankets to enjoy. Our goal is to provide free resources such as patterns, video tutorials and more.

feeds.title: Marianna's Lazy Daisy Days
feeds.description: Hii! I am Marion Leys. I love sharing my knitting & crochet patterns with others. Simple stylish knitting & crochet patterns from a popular independent designer.

feeds.title: Daisy Farm Crafts Blog
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Tiffany! I'm a grandma in training, waiting for the day I can claim the official title. My crochet blanket stack is getting taller, but I'm writing down the patterns for each blanket I make and sharing with you!

feeds.title: Crochet 'n' Create
feeds.description: After many years I started to make baby outfits as gifts for my family and friends. I decided then that it might be a good idea to write down the instructions as I crocheted an item.

feeds.title: love. life. yarn.
feeds.description: Here at love. life. yarn. we specialize in creating modern knit & crochet patterns for the whole family. This site is where I share my free knit and crochet patterns, tutorials, reviews and more!

feeds.title: Whistle and Ivy » Crochet for Baby
feeds.description: Whistle and Ivy is a crochet blog. I love designing crochet patterns and sharing them with you. Crocheting is my passion, it relieves stress, it is a creative outlet, and it is a way to show my love for those around me.

feeds.title: Mamma That Makes
feeds.description: A blog of free crochet patterns for premature and angel babies, as well as free printables, sewing and craft tutorials, and crochet patterns.

feeds.title: I Like Crochet » Baby Crochet Patterns
feeds.description: Find a wide array of baby crochet patterns including baby crochet afghans, crochet baby booties, baby crochet sweaters, hats and more. You can work these patterns up in no time because they're so small, so they're perfect for last-minute gifts before a holiday party, birthday or baby shower.
